    35	Executable examples live in docs/ui/bdd/p01-theme-core.feature. Five P01-RES bindings and exact assertion-source hashes live in docs/ui/decisions/p01-theme-traceability.json; foundation bindings remain unchanged. Resolver tests additionally execute 200 deterministic palettes with seed 20260930, reverse key order, all 31 roles/34 pairs, input nonmutation and idempotent repair. Actual dated RED/GREEN command logs reside under openspec/changes/frade-p01-theme-core/evidence. Complete FUI-005–009 scenario bindings/closure remain NOT_RUN; partial Electron oracles have executed and are listed separately in the P01 traceability registry. No screenshot or p95 baseline is approved by these pure tests.
    36	
    37	## Portable transaction service
    38	
    39	createPresentationService receives an initial validated snapshot/durable selection, session identity, a PresentationHost and a PresentationBarrier. Its register operation hides a joining participant immediately. ready resolves only after side-effect-free prepare and an exact subsequent applied-paint ACK for the current visible revision. Disposal invalidates membership/generation; hidden joins cannot reveal a previous transition. preview/commit/cancel return explicit outcomes; subscribe reports exactly did-preview/did-change/did-cancel or failure/recovery-blocked. state separates visible snapshot, committed snapshot, preview and authoritative durable revision. Inputs are copied/frozen and candidate snapshot revisions are owned by the service.
    40	
    41	States are IDLE, PREPARING, READY, BARRIER_AWAIT_PAINT, APPLYING, PERSISTING, RECONCILING_UNKNOWN, COMPENSATING, PUBLISHED, CANCELING and RECOVERY_BLOCKED. READY is a synchronous checked handoff, not an async yield point. Each phase envelope carries version1, session/request/transaction, host intent generation, snapshot revision, membership and exact phase. Participant ACKs additionally carry participant identity/generation and painted:true; an unknown field, mismatch or obsolete membership is rejected. An adapter must check AbortSignal/generation before any late mutation and acknowledge only after actual subsequent paint. A callback/message receipt is insufficient.
    42	
    43	The view queue serializes preparation, application and restoration while announceIntent is accepted before prepare. Superseded candidates cannot publish success. Prepare/apply/rollback limits are 2 seconds; host write/readback, intent ownership and reconciliation limits are 5 seconds. Timed-out prepare handles are disposed; no timeout is performance evidence. The barrier must paint a complete neutral client-area curtain before any apply and must stay covered through host durability, compensation and the single allowed membership reprepare. Preview/cancel perform no persist call. Cancel during an in-flight rename waits for reconciliation before returning, allowing the existing close/dirty-work guard to resume safely.
    44	
    45	PresentationHost owns monotonic accepted generations and the serialized atomic-rename/readback/CAS queue. The service's persist call supplies the current generation and last authoritative durable revision; an ACK must match transaction/generation/selection and advance revision. Unknown outcomes or invalidations require host-owned reconciliation to the last published selection. Compensation uses the current accepted owner, restores all required participant snapshots and rejects changed membership before reveal. A compensation/readback or rollback refusal keeps the curtain in RECOVERY_BLOCKED. recover announces a fresh owner, proves durable reconciliation and all restored paints, then returns CANCELED; failure remains covered. New preview/commit attempts cannot bypass recovery.
    46	
    47	The service has no filesystem, Electron, DOM, repository, document, selection or undo mutation APIs. Controlled tests use explicit view participants and separate dirty-document fixtures to assert preserved bytes/drafts/selection/undo, view snapshots, durable state and event ownership. Twenty-one P01-TX scenario declarations expand to 29 behavior cases; a separate integrity case checks exact assertion hashes. Additional named lifecycle and observer fault assertions execute in the same file. They execute in test:bdd together with the five pure P01-RES stories and existing bundle-flows. Host mocks and a painted-barrier fake verify the portable protocol only. Main queue/filesystem faults, actual client-area paint, frame security, bootstrap and real native/XML/model oracles remain required desktop evidence; these controlled results do not close task2.4 runtime-state coverage or task2.5 matrix evidence.
    48	
    49	Named onWillChangeTheme({previous,candidate,revision}), onDidChangeTheme({snapshot}) and onThemeChangeFailed({reason,revision}) expose copied immutable data and return disposers.
